Change c0133. Location: 1818 Vol. I, Ch. VI; 1831 Ch. VII.

Context before (unchanged): We accordingly rested on a seat until they should return.

1818 text: Presently Ernest came, and inquired if we had seen his brother: he said, that they had been playing together, that William had run away to hide himself, and that he vainly sought for him, and afterwards waited for him a long time, but that he did not return.

1831 text: Presently Ernest came, and enquired if we had seen his brother: he said, that he had been playing with him, that William had run away to hide himself, and that he vainly sought for him, and afterwards waited for him a long time, but that he did not return.

Diff: Presently Ernest came, and [-inquired-] {+enquired+} if we had seen his brother: he said, that [-they-] {+he+} had been playing [-together-] {+with him+} , that William had run away to hide himself, and that he vainly sought for him, and afterwards waited for him a long time, but that he did not return.

Context after (unchanged): "This account rather alarmed us, and we continued to search for him until night fell, when Elizabeth conjectured that he might have returned to the house.

result.rationale: "inquired" becomes "enquired" (orthographic/diction), and "they had been playing together" becomes "he had been playing with him," a syntactic rephrasing that keeps Ernest's account and the events intact.
